if(NOT TARGET glfw)
    option(GLFW_BUILD_EXAMPLES "" OFF)
    option(GLFW_BUILD_TESTS "" OFF)
    option(GLFW_BUILD_DOCS "" OFF)
    option(GLFW_INSTALL "" OFF)
    add_subdirectory(glfw)
    set_target_properties(glfw PROPERTIES FOLDER ${EXTERN_LIB_DIR}/glfw)
    set_target_properties(update_mappings PROPERTIES FOLDER ${EXTERN_LIB_DIR}/glfw)
endif()

if (NOT TARGET spdlog)
    set(SPDLOG_BUILD_SHARED)
    add_subdirectory(${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/extern/spdlog)
    set_target_properties(spdlog PROPERTIES FOLDER extern/spdlog)
endif()

set(vulkan_include ${EXTERN_LIB_DIR}/VulkanSDK/include PARENT_SCOPE)
